deadline.value: Graduate applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, with no set deadline.
deadline.quote: For Clarkson University's programs, there are no set deadlines for graduate admissions. Instead, we review applications on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for the civil and environmental engineering PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Only a limited number of tuition scholarships and stipends are offered; most are tied to department assistantships.
funding.quote: A limited number of one-year and/or partial-year tuition scholarships and stipends are available for qualified full-time students.

also.quote: Most scholarships and/or stipends for PhD candidates are associated with department assistantships.

entry_route.value: An MS in civil and environmental engineering or another engineering discipline is required for admission.
entry_route.quote: PhD Prerequisites: An MS degree from a program in civil and environmental engineering or other engineering discipline is required for admission.
